words: The 49 Financial read entry now pins its served.py member to the trunk commit that carries the forward, DB-b-319, and its sha256 is the hash of that file at HEAD; that member is the only key that moved in the entry. A new function-map entry for irpt-cot-reporting-read-lambda is the twin of it: the same source directory, the same 31 pinned members with the same re-pinned served.py, its own Terraform file, resource, IAM role and artifact key, and no deploy field, because the recorder writes those at an apply. The build-only run of both entries through the build script printed one hash for both, and the package holds 32 members that equal their sources. Not proven: nothing was uploaded, planned, applied or deployed, and the new function does not exist yet. The two entries must move together in any later re-pin of served.py. The 49 Financial function's deployed artifact differs from the artifact this map now builds only by the forward.
